title: Plastic Synthetic Turf / Recreational Needs / Climate Realities / Plastic Pollution Proliferation / Municipal Use of Artificial Turf Study / Funding
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Department of Recreation and Parks, with the collaboration and assistance of the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power, and the Los Angeles Bureau of Sanitation, Chief Legislative Analyst, and the Office of the City Administrative Officer, be instructed to report back to Council in 180 days with an analysis of the findings and recommendations in the study, taking into account recreational needs, climate realities, future funding, and plastics pollution proliferation from artificial turf, such as in ground water aquifers, soils, and storm drains. I FURTHER MOVE that up to $330,000 from the AB 1290 Fund No. 53P, Account No. 281203 (CD 3) Redevelopment Projects - Services) be transferred/appropriated to the Department of Recreation and Parks Fund No. 302, Department No. 89, Account No. 89270K (General Capital), Subaccount Synthetic Field Study to fund the artificial/synthetic turf study. I FURTHER MOVE that the Department of Recreation and Parks be authorized to confirm the total funding amount of the study prior to the transfer of funds, and make any new corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above funding transfer instructions in order to implement Mayor and Council intentions.
